name: Lupe
source:
Major: NOT being in school

Lupe is an odd girl, made entirely of hyperactivity, it seems. Always with sloppily crazy antics, manages to drive anyone nuts. She likes Yellow candies and playing catch with small objects. it "helps to improve her reflexes", she says. She can often be seen in school uniform, but is rarely in school. Why could that be?

[From [url=http://corruptpolygons.com/]Corrupt Polygons[/url]]
